skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Over the City of Sweets
skins.content: Persona 3 Reload Collaboration Outfit/Over the City of Sweets. The outfit Koromaru often wore in Laterano. Every dessert in the city has floated up into the sky, circling Koromaru and begging him to take just one bite—what, it's a dream?!
skins.usage: An outfit Koromaru received in Laterano.
skins.quote: They all dreamed a dream within a dream, and woke still smiling at the corners of their mouths—that is what a good sleep is.
